meaning: have to; cannot help but (a double negative)

senses.en: have to; cannot help but (a double negative)

note: Stronger than 必须 in tone: "it would be wrong not to".

examples.zh: 今天的会很重要，你不能不参加。
examples.en: Today's meeting is important, so you have to attend.

examples.zh: 孩子病了，我不能不请假。
examples.en: My child is sick, so I have to take leave.

examples.zh: 他帮过我们，我们不能不感谢他。
examples.en: He has helped us, so we must thank him.

examples.zh: 这里的冬天很冷，很多人家还烧煤。
examples.en: Winters here are cold, and many households still burn coal.

examples.zh: 这块煤很重，你一个人搬得动吗？
examples.en: This lump of coal is heavy. Can you carry it by yourself?

examples.zh: 现在很多地方不用煤做饭了。
examples.en: Many places no longer cook with coal now.

note: Objects: 合同, 协议, 条约. Formal; for everyday signing, 签 is enough.

examples.zh: 我们昨天和公司签订了合同。
examples.en: We signed the contract with the company yesterday.

examples.zh: 合同还没签订，你先别告诉别人。
examples.en: The contract isn't signed yet, so don't tell anyone for now.

examples.zh: 他们打算什么时候签订协议？
examples.en: When do they plan to sign the agreement?

note: Typical for neighbor, family or labor disputes; the mediator is a third party.

examples.zh: 邻居吵架了，社区的人来调解。
examples.en: The neighbors had a quarrel, and people from the community came to mediate.

examples.zh: 他想请老师帮他们调解。
examples.en: He wants to ask the teacher to mediate between them.

examples.zh: 经过调解，两家都不生气了。
examples.en: After mediation, neither family was angry anymore.

meaning: to be beneficial to; to be good for

senses.en: to be beneficial to; to be good for

note: Followed by a noun or verb phrase: 有利于 健康 / 有利于 提高. Opposite: 不利于.

examples.zh: 早睡觉有利于身体健康。
examples.en: Going to bed early is good for your health.

examples.zh: 这样做有利于我们的工作吗？
examples.en: Will doing it this way benefit our work?

examples.zh: 多听多说有利于提高汉语水平。
examples.en: Listening and speaking more helps improve your Chinese level.

meaning: to correspond to; to match (one to one)

senses.en: to correspond to; to match (one to one)

note: Often 与/和……对应, or 对应的 + noun.

examples.zh: 这个词在英语里有对应的说法吗？
examples.en: Does this word have an equivalent expression in English?

examples.zh: 表格里每个名字都对应一个号码。
examples.en: In the table, each name corresponds to a number.

examples.zh: 这两个数字不对应，请再检查。
examples.en: These two numbers don't match. Please check again.

meaning: to open (a conference, fair, games, show)

senses.en: to open (a conference, fair, games, show)

note: Opposite: 闭幕. Used for events, not shops.

examples.zh: 博览会明天上午九点开幕。
examples.en: The expo opens at nine tomorrow morning.

examples.zh: 运动会什么时候开幕？
examples.en: When does the sports meet open?

examples.zh: 听说开幕那天会来很多人。
examples.en: I hear lots of people will come on the opening day.

meaning: to do well; to get (something) properly done

senses.en: to do well; to get (something) properly done

note: 搞好 + 关系/工作/卫生 are common.

examples.zh: 我想搞好和同事的关系。
examples.en: I want to build a good relationship with my colleagues.

examples.zh: 要搞好工作，先要休息好。
examples.en: To do your work well, you first need good rest.

examples.zh: 你能帮我搞好这份报告吗？
examples.en: Can you help me get this report done properly?

note: Usually after a person: 妈妈跟前, 我跟前.

examples.zh: 孩子跑到妈妈跟前，哭了。
examples.en: The child ran up to Mom and cried.

examples.zh: 请走到我跟前来。
examples.en: Please come over to me.

examples.zh: 他就站在我跟前，我却没看见。
examples.en: He was standing right in front of me, but I didn't see him.

examples.zh: 消费者都希望买到便宜又好的东西。
examples.en: Consumers all hope to buy things that are cheap and good.

examples.zh: 这家店很重视消费者的意见。
examples.en: This store takes consumers' opinions seriously.

examples.zh: 消费者买东西前最好多比较。
examples.en: Consumers had better compare more before buying.

note: Household cooking gas in China is often called 煤气 or 天然气.

examples.zh: 我家做饭用天然气。
examples.en: We use natural gas for cooking at home.

examples.zh: 天然气的价格又涨了。
examples.en: The price of natural gas has gone up again.

examples.zh: 用天然气要注意安全。
examples.en: You must pay attention to safety when using natural gas.

meaning: to ride in a vehicle; to take a bus or car

senses.en: to ride in a vehicle; to take a bus or car

note: Written/announcement style; in speech, 坐车 is more common.

examples.zh: 乘车前请先买票。
examples.en: Please buy a ticket before boarding.

examples.zh: 请问，在哪儿乘车去机场？
examples.en: Excuse me, where do I catch a ride to the airport?

examples.zh: 乘车时不要大声说话。
examples.en: Don't talk loudly while riding.

examples.zh: 老师让我们大声朗读课文。
examples.en: The teacher had us read the text aloud.

examples.zh: 我每天早上朗读十分钟英语。
examples.en: I read English aloud for ten minutes every morning.

examples.zh: 你能朗读这篇文章吗？
examples.en: Can you read this article aloud?

note: Describes mood on the face: 神情紧张, 神情严肃.

examples.zh: 她的神情很紧张。
examples.en: She looks very nervous.

examples.zh: 看他的神情，好像不太高兴。
examples.en: Judging by his look, he doesn't seem very happy.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他的神情变了。
examples.en: Hearing the news, the look on his face changed.

examples.zh: 这座水库为城市提供水。
examples.en: This reservoir supplies water to the city.

examples.zh: 周末我们去水库看吧。
examples.en: Let's go to the reservoir this weekend.

examples.zh: 夏天雨水少，水库的水很少。
examples.en: Rain is scarce in summer, so the reservoir is low.

note: 棵 for a plant, 根 for a cut piece.

examples.zh: 大熊猫喜欢吃竹子。
examples.en: Pandas like to eat bamboo.

examples.zh: 院子里种着几棵竹子。
examples.en: A few bamboo plants are growing in the yard.

examples.zh: 这把椅子是用竹子做的。
examples.en: This chair is made of bamboo.

examples.zh: 今天天气晴朗，适合出去。
examples.en: The weather is clear today, good for going out.

examples.zh: 天空晴朗，一朵云也没有。
examples.en: The sky is clear, without a single cloud.

examples.zh: 明天会是个晴朗的好天气。
examples.en: Tomorrow will be a fine, clear day.

note: Written/math register; in speech use 比……大 or 超过.

examples.zh: 五大于三。
examples.en: Five is greater than three.

examples.zh: 这个数大于十吗？
examples.en: Is this number greater than ten?

examples.zh: 报名的人大于三十个，就分成两个班。
examples.en: If more than thirty people sign up, we'll split into two classes.

note: Typical subjects: 价格, 房价, 水位.

examples.zh: 最近价格一直在上涨。
examples.en: Prices have been rising lately.

examples.zh: 菜的价格为什么又上涨了？
examples.en: Why have vegetable prices gone up again?

examples.zh: 汽油价格上涨，开车的人都觉得压力大。
examples.en: With fuel prices rising, drivers all feel the pressure.

note: Figurative: 文章有水分 means padded; 数据有水分 means inflated.

examples.zh: 西瓜的水分很多。
examples.en: Watermelon has a lot of water in it.

examples.zh: 多吃水果可以补充水分。
examples.en: Eating more fruit can replenish your water.

examples.zh: 这篇文章水分太多，内容很少。
examples.en: This article is padded, with little real content.
